subject: Game Theory
title: Technology Standards Wars
description: Learn Technology Standards Wars in one minute.

hook.text: VHS beat Betamax. Blu-ray beat HD DVD. USB-C is beating everything. Standards wars are strategic games.

buildup.text: When a product becomes the standard, network effects lock in customers and lock out competitors.

discovery.text: Firms use strategies like early licensing, bundling, and subsidizing complementary products to win adoption.

twist.text: The better technology doesn't always win. VHS was inferior to Betamax but had better ecosystem strategy.

climax.text: Standards wars are coordination games: everyone benefits from one standard, but which one is the battle.
